sms.otp: Ikhodi yakho ye-Sgela ngu-{code}. Iphelelwa yisikhathi emizuzwini emi-5. Ungayabelani nomuntu.
sms.guardianInvite: Sawubona {guardian}, u-{learner} ujoyine i-Sgela, uhlelo lwamahhala lokufunda ngemisebenzi oluvela ku-Veza. Sicela ufunde bese unikeza imvume lapha: {link}
sms.guardianReminder: Isikhumbuzo: u-{learner} usalinde imvume yakho ukuze asebenzise i-Sgela ngokugcwele. Funda bese uphendula lapha: {link}

start.title: Londoloza imiphumela yakho
start.intro: Bhalisa ngenombolo yakho yocingo. Sizokuthumelela ikhodi yezinombolo ezi-6 nge-SMS. Akudingeki iphasiwedi.
start.trustDevice: Ngigcine ngingenile kulolu cingo izinsuku ezingama-30
start.doneRestricted: Ungaqala ukufunda manje. Amathuba nezimemo zizovuleka uma umzali noma umbheki wakho evumile.
start.doneNoResults: Ubudlale e-expo ye-Veza? Engeza ikhodi yakho noma nini ku-Mina.

profile.title: Mayelana nawe
profile.schoolHint: Qala ukubhala ukuze usesha. Uma isikole sakho singekho ohlwini, bhala igama laso.

errors.phoneInvalid: Faka inombolo yeselula yaseNingizimu Afrika, isib. 071 234 5678.
errors.codeWrong: Leyo khodi ayilungile. Usele namathuba angu-{left}.
errors.codeExpired: Leyo khodi isiphelelwe yisikhathi. Cela entsha.
errors.codeLocked: Uzame kaningi kakhulu. Cela ikhodi entsha.
errors.resendTooSoon: Sicela ulinde imizuzwana engu-{seconds} ngaphambi kokucela futhi.
errors.rateLimited: Kucelwe amakhodi amaningi kakhulu. Zama futhi emizuzwini engu-{minutes}.
errors.tooYoung: Kumele okungenani ube neminyaka eyi-10 ukuze ubhalise.
errors.gradeInvalid: Khetha ibanga kusukela ku-8 kuya ku-12.
errors.guardianSamePhone: Sebenzisa inombolo yomzali noma yombheki wakho, hhayi eyakho.
errors.generic: Kukhona okungahambanga kahle. Sicela uzame futhi.

guardian.title: Umzali noma umbheki wakho
guardian.intro: Ngoba awukafiki eminyakeni eyi-18, umzali noma umbheki kumele avume ngaphambi kokuthi sikuxhumanise namathuba. Sizomthumelela isixhumanisi.
guardian.name: Igama lakhe
guardian.sentNote: Uze avume, ungafunda, kodwa abaxhasi abakuboni futhi awutholi zimemo.

consent.title: Izinqumo zakho zobumfihlo
consent.intro: Khetha ukuthi i-Sgela ingalusebenzisa kanjani ulwazi lwakho. Ungakushintsha noma nini ku-Mina, Ubumfihlo nemvume.
consent.PLATFORM: Sebenzisa i-Sgela ukufunda nokulandelela inqubekela phambili yami
consent.PLATFORMHelp: Kuyadingeka ukuze usebenzise uhlelo. Sigcina iphrofayela yakho, inqubekela phambili nemiphumela ye-expo.
consent.MATCHINGHelp: Siqhathanisa iphrofayela yakho namathuba. Abaxhasi babona imininingwane yakho kuphela uma ufaka isicelo.
consent.PARTNER_CONTACT: Vumela abalingani ukuthi baxhumane nami ngemva kokwamukela isimemo
consent.MARKETINGHelp: I-SMS noma i-WhatsApp ngezikhathi ezithile. Akukho spam.
consent.guardianIntro: U-{name} ujoyine i-Sgela, uhlelo lwamahhala oluvela ku-Veza olusiza intsha yaseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi ihlole imisebenzi, ifunde amakhono futhi ithole imifundaze nemisebenzi.
consent.guardianWhat1: Igama, usuku lokuzalwa, inombolo yocingo, isifundazwe, isifunda, isikole nebanga, ukuze sibonise izifundo ezifanele.
consent.guardianWhat2: Inqubekela phambili yokufunda nemiphumela ye-VR expo, ukuze sincome izinyathelo ezilandelayo.
consent.guardianWhat3: Asilokothi sidayise ulwazi. Abaxhasi babona izibalo eziphelele kuphela, ngaphandle uma u-{name} efaka isicelo sethuba olivumile.
consent.guardianWhat4: Ungayihoxisa imvume noma nini ngokuxhumana ne-Veza.
consent.guardianThanksDecline: U-{name} usengafunda ku-Sgela kodwa ngeke axhunyaniswe namathuba.
consent.invalidBody: Kungenzeka ukuthi siphelelwe yisikhathi noma sithathelwe indawo yi-SMS entsha. Cela umfundi ukuthi asithumele futhi kusuka ohlelweni.
consent.guardianMATCHINGHelp: Siqhathanisa iphrofayela ka-{name} namathuba. Abaxhasi babona imininingwane kuphela uma u-{name} efaka isicelo.
consent.guardianPARTNER_CONTACT: Vumela abalingani ukuthi baxhumane no-{name} ngemva kokwamukelwa kwesimemo

claim.expiredBody: Amakhodi ahlala izinsuku ezingama-30. Usengabhalisa futhi uhlole imisebenzi.
claim.usedBody: Ikhodi ngayinye ingalondolozwa ngumuntu oyedwa kuphela.
claim.mineTitle: Le miphumela isivele ilondoloziwe ku-akhawunti yakho
claim.addIntro: Ubudlale e-expo ye-Veza? Faka ikhodi yezinhlamvu ezi-6 esekhadini lakho.

me.restrictedBody: Sithumele u-{guardian} isixhumanisi. Aze avume, ungafunda kodwa ngeke uthole izimemo zamathuba.

photo.title: Isithombe sephrofayela
photo.body: Nguwe kuphela ongasibona isithombe sakho. Asikaze siboniswe abaxhasi noma abanye abafundi.
photo.hint: JPG, PNG noma WebP, kuze kufike ku-5 MB.

errors.TOO_BIG: Leso sithombe sikhulu kuno-5 MB. Zama esincane.
errors.NOT_AN_IMAGE: Lelo fayela akusona isithombe se-JPG, PNG noma WebP.
errors.TOO_SMALL: Leso sithombe sincane kakhulu. Sebenzisa esinobubanzi obungama-pixel angu-64 okungenani.

privacy.title: Ubumfihlo nemvume
privacy.intro: Lezi yizinqumo zakho zamanje. Ushintsho ngalunye lulondolozwa njengerekhodi elisha.
privacy.minorNote: Ngoba awukafiki eminyakeni eyi-18, ngumbheki wakho kuphela ongakuvula lokhu. Wena ungakuvala.
privacy.platformLocked: Kuyadingeka ukuze usebenzise i-Sgela. Ukuze uyeke ukusebenzisa i-Sgela, sicele ukuthi sisuse i-akhawunti yakho.

home.title: I-Career Compass yakho
